card.name: The verb seem after a subject
card.fires_on: The verb "seem" or "seems" or "seemed", mostly in general web prose right after a subject such as a problem, a world or "it", before "to" or "that".

modes.label: seem after a subject
modes.description: The verb seem/seems/seemed follows a noun or "it" and introduces an impression.
modes.example: The sales world<< seems>> to be in a state of constant change

modes.label: Stray other words
modes.description: A few weaker hits fall on other words such as "on" or "to" in similar trend statements.
modes.example: Childhood asthma is<< on>> the rise in the United States, especially

card.plain: It lights up on the word "seems" when a writer describes how things appear to be.
